findings.claim: 0005 and 0006 Consequences overstated when the action fails and that every unverified concept is due
cut-off skill summaries in the briefing read poorly

verdict.text: All three findings sent back are fixed, and the fixes broke nothing I could find.
The gates and rows pass on the new tree.
`loopctl gate stamp` in the worktree: lint, format, tests and rows r1 to r5 pass, "stamp green: 03aa1cd83749d2384702c931a508e2ff594e1a9450381991a5140e7613a578d5".
0005's new lines against action/knowledge-ci.sh: it sets a failing status only when `kmctl check` exits non-zero or `kmctl review due` exits non-zero, and due concepts never fail it.
Against action/knowledge-audit.sh and audit-report.py: a non-zero claude exit or no usable findings block exits 1, and a finding with verdict drifted does not change the exit code.
The script also exits 1 for a refused event or a failed `review due`.
The record does not list those, but nothing it says is false.
0006 against src/kmctl/review_due.py: concepts under handoffs/ go only to expired_handoffs once stale_after has passed, and are never marked "unverified".
action.yml's description now matches the header of knowledge-ci.sh.
`uv run kmctl briefing`: the three review skills now give a whole line ("Review instructions for ..., used through /audit and its kmctl-auditor agent.").
handoff and write-docs still cut at 12 words with "...", and no trailing comma comes before the ellipsis.
The briefing is 526 words, against a budget of 600.
briefing.py is staged and passes ruff format --check.
f1: resolved in .okf/decisions/0005-audits-report-only.md, .okf/decisions/0006-staleness-from-okf-fields.md and action.yml, as checked above.
f2: resolved by the `rstrip(",;:")` in `_skill_summary` and the reworded descriptions in the three review SKILL.md files.
`git status` shows briefing.py fully staged, and the format gate passes.
